details.text: `[MEDIUM]`: no change is blamed. About 0 GB was free after graph capture, because the 32 GB aiter decode workspace sits outside the static memory budget.

details.label: Miles MI35x: the router never registered the engine
details.text: `[MEDIUM]`: no change is blamed. The router's `discover_metadata` step (3 × 10 s) raced the engine becoming ready.

details.text: `[LOW]`: no change is blamed. Inductor's lazy compile of the CI-only `_assert_nonneg_and_invalidate` (`overlap_utils.py:77`) stalled, and the 300 s watchdog killed the server. The Nov 3 Miles DSv4 session-server deadlock stalled in the same function. This was the test's first nightly run after [#48134](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/48134) moved it; its 10 earlier runs passed.

details.text: `[LOW]`: no change is blamed. Free memory fell from 21.6 GB to 0 GB during capture, and `HSA_STATUS_ERROR_OUT_OF_RESOURCES` followed. The test passed in the 9 earlier rocm720 runs and in today's rocm10 nightly with the same file order. Fix: ❌.
